notes: The 'Create Final_Tourism table' stage of tourism.sas (PROC FORMAT for continent_fmt, PROC SORT, the two MERGE...BY Country data steps producing Final_Tourism and NoCountryFound, PROC FREQ on Category, PROC MEANS with CLASS Continent) copied verbatim. The original built its cleaned_tourism/country_info inputs from libname cr pointed at ~/ECRB94/data (cr.tourism, cr.country_info) via a DATA _null_/fill-down pass earlier in the file that has its own typos (`them` instead of `then`) unrelated to this stage; substituted here with small inline DATALINES shaped like the columns that earlier stage produces (Country_Name/Tourism_Type/Category/Series/Y2014 and Country/Continent), including one country (Nomanistan) deliberately absent from country_info so NoCountryFound has a row to find.
